pkgmetadata.longdescription: Hew is a cross-platform 3D modeler: SketchUp's draw-on-faces and push/pull interaction model on a solids-first kernel where every closed extrusion is a watertight object. It opens and saves SketchUp files of every version, from SketchUp 3 through 2027. This package installs the official binary release (the desktop app and the hew-cli sidecar).
